claim: Real-estate/design press lists gothic 'remixed into whimsigoth' among the hottest fall 2026 home design trends.
excerpt: Search summary: recommends jewel tones, velvet, lace, botanicals (especially herbs) and vintage or apothecary-flair decor for staging; the same summary said whimsigoth has driven 'millions of impressions' on social media around Practical Magic 2's September premiere (attribution to this article probable, not certain; no source for that number given).
title: 5 Fall Design Trends That Real Estate Agents Should Know In 2026
